balanceFollowup.cause: Mtub was rewritten to Bitcoin ypub, causing Litecoin Blockbook to derive the wrong address class and return a false zero. Pending UTXO changes were also ignored and advertised forceRefresh did not bypass the cache. Receive script labels and overlapping derivation responses could disagree with the selected account.
fixes: Preserve Litecoin Mtub; validate script/address/path families in live deployment checks
Include signed pending UTXO balance changes with exact base-unit arithmetic
Honor forced refresh and report upstream failure instead of accepting stale verified zeros
Keep selected script, derivation path, address metadata and extended-key classification consistent; suppress stale asynchronous derivations
